statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds a QNAP NAS vulnerability tied to the Plex2Shell attacks, with a dateAdded value between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog lists a QNAP CVE linked to Plex2Shell exploitation with dateAdded from 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-30 inclusive; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No QNAP CVE associated with Plex2Shell carries a KEV dateAdded value between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-30.

statement: The ICE Brent front-month futures settlement on 2026-12-18 is below 95.00 USD per barrel. Reference: 98.32 USD on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the ICE Brent front-month official settlement price for 2026-12-18 is below 95.00 USD; FALSE if it is 95.00 or higher.
failure_condition: The Brent front-month settlement on 2026-12-18 is at or above 95.00 USD per barrel.

statement: US forces conduct at least one new strike on Iranian territory between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-22, acknowledged by the White House, Pentagon or CENTCOM.
resolution: TRUE if the White House, DoD or CENTCOM acknowledges a US strike on Iranian territory occurring 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-22, as reported by Reuters or AP; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No US strike on Iranian territory occurring between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-22 is officially acknowledged by the US government.

statement: Russia and Ukraine both formally announce a general ceasefire covering the whole front line taking effect between 2026-11-09 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: TRUE if both the Russian and Ukrainian governments officially announce a front-wide ceasefire taking effect 2026-11-09 to 2027-01-31, reported by Reuters or AP; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No front-wide ceasefire announced by both governments takes effect between 2026-11-09 and 2027-01-31.

statement: Hakeem Jeffries is elected Speaker of the House in a roll call vote held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-08.
resolution: TRUE if the House Clerk or Congress.gov roll call record shows Jeffries elected Speaker in a vote held 2027-01-03 to 2027-01-08; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Jeffries is not elected Speaker in any House roll call between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-08.

statement: A New Zealand Prime Minister is sworn in or reappointed at the head of a newly formed government between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if Government House or DPMC records the swearing-in of a government formed after the 2026 election between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No post-election government is sworn in in New Zealand between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-11.

statement: Polish prosecutors formally charge at least one person over the Krakow shooting between 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: TRUE if Polish prosecutors announce charges against a suspect in the Krakow shooting between 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-20, reported by Reuters, AP or PAP; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No person is formally charged over the Krakow shooting between 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-20.

statement: The criminal trial of Alfozan in the OpenAI bugging case begins with jury selection or opening statements between 2026-11-09 and 2027-03-31.
resolution: TRUE if the federal court docket shows jury selection or opening statements in the Alfozan case between 2026-11-09 and 2027-03-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No trial proceedings begin in the Alfozan case between 2026-11-09 and 2027-03-31.

statement: GDACS issues an Orange or Red earthquake alert for an event in Japan occurring between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the GDACS archive shows an Orange or Red earthquake alert for a Japan event dated 2026-11-09 to 2026-12-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No Japan earthquake occurring between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-31 carries an Orange or Red GDACS alert level.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds at least one additional SonicWall SonicOS CVE with a dateAdded value between 2026-11-09 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog lists a SonicWall SonicOS CVE other than CVE-2026-19868 with dateAdded from 2026-11-09 to 2027-01-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No SonicWall SonicOS CVE other than CVE-2026-19868 has a KEV dateAdded value between 2026-11-09 and 2027-01-31.
